qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Niche B2B market leadership across Dental consumables, Brokk demolition robots (~70% global share), and specialized engineering systems. High customer switching costs and mission-critical applications enable continuous pricing ahead of inflation. 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 21.4% (including accumulated goodwill) provides robust empirical proof of moat.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Elite Swedish serial acquirer with a disciplined decentralized model, acquiring niche B2B market leaders at modest multiples. Outstanding capital efficiency with a 21.4% 5-year median GAAP ROIC, >100% FCF conversion, and net debt under 0.7x earnings. qualitative.evidence: Exceptional multi-cycle financial performance: 5-year median GAAP ROIC 21.42% (FY2022 21.7%, FY2023 24.8%, FY2024 21.2%, FY2025 19.4%). Owner FCF conversion averages 118% (FY2025 Owner FCF SEK 4,582M vs Net Income SEK 3,633M). Fortress balance sheet with net debt / NI <0.7x and EBIT interest coverage of 12.6x.
